citation.verbatim: Each record holder of common stock as of the close of market on Thursday, June 6, 2024 will receive nine additional shares of common stock, to be distributed after the close of market on Friday, June 7, 2024. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on Monday, June 10, 2024.

D1.decision: Process the mandatory 10-for-1 split using the 2024-06-06 record-date position; maintain the already split-adjusted PCF quantity and confirm the post-distribution position. No election is available or required. Hold only the June dividend net-cash receivable pending withholding documentation.

citation.verbatim: The Amendment became effective at 4:01 p.m. Eastern Time on June 7, 2024. Exhibit 3.1: At the Effective Time, each share of Common Stock issued as of immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be automatically subdivided and reclassified into ten (10) validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable shares of Common Stock. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on June 10, 2024.

D1.decision: Effectuate the mandatory 10-for-1 split under the June 7 effectiveness 8-K using the 18,000-share eligible position; maintain the already split-adjusted PCF at 1,800 shares per creation unit and confirm 180,000 shares as of June 7. No election is available or required. Hold only the June dividend net-cash receivable pending withholding documentation.
